witness.branch: Displayed lights without cowl or parking lamps
witness.quote: Whenever lights are displayed upon a vehicle lawfully parked at nighttime upon any highway, such lights shall be depressed or dimmed, in the event cowl or parking lamps are not used.
witness.reason: The parking maneuver remains compatible with the nighttime light conditions; a lane marking alone establishes none of them.
